hypothesis: logic/governance-evolution.schema.json enums for artifact_type and event.type no longer match real entries in state/evolution/. Updating the schema to extend the enums with the in-use values (and continuing to update them as new event types emerge) will let validation succeed on real data and remove a hidden source of cycle-time noise.

risks: Cementing accidental vocabulary — review whether event types should consolidate (e.g. is 'gap_identified' really distinct from 'pattern_detected'?) before extending blindly
Schema drift becomes a habit — pair this with a CI validator so future drifts surface within a day, not 27
